meta.title: Fix always-true condition in LazyItemEvaluator metadata expansion logic
meta.body_summary: Fix always-true condition (Count >= 0) in LazyItemEvaluator.LazyItemOperation.cs that disabled an optimization path for metadata expansion; evolve through review feedback to simplify redundant if/else and remove outdated comments.

perf_labels.notes: Simple logical fix that needed human guidance to completely remove redundant branches and comments; merged without performance benchmarks.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 36 changed lines in one file, this is an extremely small edit. It fits a tiny, focused performance fix PR that restores an optimization path; the outcome (merged) is consistent with the low risk.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer YuliiaKovalova first questioned how the initial condition fix alone resolves the issue, then identified redundant branches and an outdated UNDONE comment, driving multiple rounds of simplification until the final merged state.
review_details.performance_claim: Restore the optimization path that avoids unnecessary per-item metadata expansion when no item list references are present.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: always_true_condition (prior bug; not in taxonomy enum)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple logical bug fix in a C# evaluator; Copilot could deliver the fix but required human guidance to fully simplify the surrounding control flow and documentation.

detection_detail.code_reading: YuliiaKovalova reviewed the code inline, questioned the correctness, identified redundant else branch and outdated comment, and guided Copilot through multiple simplification commits.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks, profiling, or performance numbers; the fix is purely logical and was accepted after manual reasoning.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All review-driven changes were incorporated within this PR through additional commits: removing redundant else branch, simplifying if/else structure, and deleting outdated comment.

core_change_summary.description: In NeedToExpandMetadataForEachItem, changed `_referencedItemLists.Count >= 0` to `> 0`, then simplified the entire if/else block to directly set `needToExpandMetadataForEachItem = true` when metadata is present, and removed an outdated UNDONE comment.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes are confined to a single file; no secondary files touched.
change_trajectory: Initial fix (dcbdbcb): changed >= to > in the condition.
Removed redundant inner condition in else branch (7c6e91d).
Simplified entire if/else to always set needToExpandMetadataForEachItem = true when metadata is present (be04ec94).

review_signals.summary: Questioned how the original >= to > change alone helps with the problem described in the ticket.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot provided explanation and later simplified the entire logic per maintainer's subsequent feedback.

review_signals.summary: Pointed out that the else branch had a redundant condition (already inside the outer if) and requested a review of the outdated comment.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed the redundant else branch, then further simplified the if/else and deleted the comment.

review_signals.summary: Asked whether the UNDONE comment was still relevant after the logic simplification.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed the comment in a later commit.

review_signals.summary: APPROVED after all simplifications were completed.
APPROVED with note: 'less code is always nice to see'.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with a one-line condition fix.
YuliiaKovalova questioned the fix's logic, prompting Copilot to explain and later guided simplification of redundant branches.
Multiple commits removed redundant else condition, simplified the if/else, and cleaned up outdated comments.
After all iterations, YuliiaKovalova, SimaTian, and rainersigwald approved; PR merged after ~284 hours.
